title: What is Python?
content: Python is a high-level programming language known for its simple syntax and readability.

title: What is FastAPI?
content: FastAPI is a Python framework used to build fast and modern APIs.

title: What is an API?
content: An API allows two software applications to communicate with each other.

title: What is CRUD?
content: CRUD stands for Create, Read, Update, and Delete. These operations are used to manage data.

title: What is JSON?
content: JSON is a data format used to store and exchange structured information.

title: What is Pydantic?
content: Pydantic validates data using Python type annotations and models.

title: What is a REST API?
content: A REST API uses HTTP methods and URLs to access and manage resources.

title: What is HTTP GET?
content: GET is an HTTP method used to retrieve data from a server.

title: What is HTTP POST?
content: POST is an HTTP method used to submit data and commonly create new resources.

title: What is HTTP PUT?
content: PUT is an HTTP method commonly used to replace an existing resource.

title: What is HTTP DELETE?
content: DELETE is an HTTP method used to request the removal of a resource.

title: What is HTTP 404?
content: HTTP status code 404 means the requested resource was not found.

title: What is a database?
content: A database stores and organizes information so applications can retrieve and manage it.

title: What is SQLite?
content: SQLite is a lightweight relational database that stores its data in a file.

title: What is PostgreSQL?
content: PostgreSQL is an open-source relational database management system.

title: What is RAG?
content: Retrieval-Augmented Generation retrieves relevant information and provides it to a language model to help generate answers.

title: What are embeddings?
content: Embeddings are numerical vectors that represent the meaning or features of text and other data.

title: What is a vector database?
content: A vector database stores embeddings and supports similarity searches to find semantically related information.

title: What is chunking in RAG?
content: Chunking divides large documents into smaller sections that can be indexed and retrieved.

title: What are citations in RAG?
content: Citations identify the source documents or passages that support a generated answer.

title: what is Deep Learning
content: it is a branch if AI in which we have deep Neural networks to understand and build AI models
